content.text:
I fixed the false "broken anchor" errors. A link like `/docs/php/tooling#phpunit` was being flagged when the page had been recorded as `/docs/php/tooling/`, with a trailing slash.

**Cause:** The link checker already treats `/page` and `/page/` as the same page when deciding whether a link's path exists. The anchor check didn't: it looked the page up by its exact path. When the link and the recorded page differed only by a trailing slash, it found no page, so it reported every anchor on that page as broken.

**Fix:** In `isAnchorBrokenLink` in `packages/docusaurus/src/server/brokenLinks.ts`, if the exact path finds nothing, it now also tries the path with the trailing slash added and with it removed (plain and URL-decoded). This doesn't loosen the check on whether the page itself exists, because that check runs first.

The existing broken-links test suite passes (34 tests). I didn't add a test for this case, and I didn't run a full site build to reproduce the issue's example.
